QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Clerk
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bBianca#k, a student at the magic academy.
QuestInfo.1: Go see #bHirrel#k the clerk. He likes to loiter around the town hall on the left side of town.

0.0: If you're so big on Kritias's history, why don't you bug #bHirrel#k about it? He's the big brain over at town hall.

yes.0: Just head west. You'll find Hirrel hanging outside town hall. He's been going crazy ever since the academy got shut down. Seems the egghead misses our library...

no.0: Oh, so you DON'T care. Well. Neither do I!

1.0: You aren't on my friends registry. And you aren't on the visitor registry, either. I should know, for I'm the head clerk!\r\n#L0##b(You explain everything that's happened, then you ask him why there are no records of this kingdom anywhere else in Maple World.)#l\n#k
1.1: No records of our existence? Inconceivable! Why, if there were no records of Kritias, I'd have recorded it!

yes.0: This is simply too absurd. Please give me a moment to compose myself...

npc.0: What're you looking at me for? Go find Hirrel. He's on the west side, near the town hall.
